title: Number Merge
description: Slide the numbered tiles and merge matching numbers to make bigger ones. Can you build a 2048 tile? A simple, addictive sliding puzzle that is easy to learn and hard to master.
instructions: Use the arrow keys or WASD to slide every tile in that direction.
On a phone or tablet, swipe up, down, left or right.
When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one.
A new tile appears after every move. Keep merging to reach 2048!
Press N to start a new game.
